title: Mmepɔw a Wɔasen no Nkɔmhyɛni
intro: Wɔ tete Arabia anhweatam a ɛso yɛ den so no, onipa bi puei wɔ nnipa a wɔagye din wɔ wɔn nsaanodwuma soronko mu no mu. Wɔn afie sɔre fi abotan a ɛyɛ den mu, nanso na wɔn koma yɛ den sen mmepɔw a wodi adwini no. Ɔsoro ɔbɔfo bi de anwonwade sɛnkyerɛnne biako bae — nanso ahantan ne asoɔden de nea efii mu bae ntɛmntɛm na ɛyɛ hu bae. So wubetumi ahu akoa a ɔyɛ ɔdehye a ne nkurɔfo paw ɔsɛe sen akwankyerɛ no?
clues: Wɔsomaa me sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ maa me nkurɔfoɔ, na mefrɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmɛsom Onyankopɔn Baako no.
Ná me nkurɔfo te abotan a ɛyɛ nwonwa mu, na wodi adwini a ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ mmepɔw no so.
Yoma babea bi a ɔyɛ anwonwade fii ɔbotan a ɛyɛ den mu puei wɔ me mpaebɔ mu, na ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a emu da hɔ a efi Ade Nyinaa so Tumfoɔ no hɔ.
Meka kyerɛɛ me nkurɔfo sɛ wɔne yoma abere yi nkyɛ nsu no na wɔmmpira no.
Me nkurɔfo bɔɔ pɔw tiaa yoma ba no na wɔbɔɔ ne nan ase, na wɔsɔɔ wɔn ankasa ɔsɛe ano.
Asasewosow a ɛyɛ hu sii me nkurɔfo, na wogyaw wɔn a wɔhwee ase a wonhinhim wɔ wɔn atrae.

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
